President Trump dismissed concerns about AI causing human extinction, telling reporters in Dallas, "No, I don't have any."
“I have concerns that if we don’t win AI, we’re going to be put in a very bad position," Trump reportedly said. He claimed the US is leading China in AI right now, according to Bloomberg.
The comments come as lawmakers from both sides of the aisle urge the Trump administration to increase regulation of the AI industry, following the resignation of an Anthropic
researcher this week. The researcher publicly
that “the people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.”

title: Trump shrugs off AI existential threat warnings
